note: Role: trader/merchant of API and pharma intermediates, not a manufacturer — the visible customs rows show it buying cytosine, Gemcitabine HCl, Bendamustine HCl and similar intermediates from Chinese suppliers (Beijing Toachem, Shandong Lixin, Weihai Can Rong) and re-selling; the single confirmed outbound row is a Bendamustine HCl shipment to Vietnam. Declared HS 293339 does not match the observed codes: the visible records carry 29339990, 29335990 and 29321990, so the factual code should be corrected to 29339990 (heterocyclic compounds, other) with 29335990 as secondary — per project rule 3 this is NOT grounds for rejection, verdict would be accepted_hs_corrected. Registered address on the customs record: 12th floor, 121 Atlanta Premises Co-op. Soc. Ltd., Jamnalal Bajaj Marg, Nariman Point, Mumbai, Maharashtra — consistent with the claimed state. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in any source reached; not estimated. PAN AAKCR7053H and CIN were not verifiable (registry sources blocked), so they are left as claimed-only, not confirmed. Sanctions/litigation: not assessed in this pass and, per rule 2, not a rejection ground. Bottom line: real export shipments exist (1 dated B/L to Vietnam), so this is not a 'no trace of supply' case; domestic India-side supply remains unverified rather than absent.
